changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dsr_cases ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, case_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, investor_unique_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, jurisdiction VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_description TEXT NOT NULL, requester_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, requester_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, requester_phone VARCHAR(64), requester_role VARCHAR(64), supporting_file_path VARCHAR(512), status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, sla_deadline TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, assigned_to VARCHAR(255), resolution_notes TEXT, resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_dsr_cases_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_dsr_cases_case_id UNIQUE (case_id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_cases_investor_unique_code ON dsr_cases(investor_unique_code); CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_cases_status_sla ON dsr_cases(status, sla_deadline);

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE dsr_cases ADD COLUMN data_area VARCHAR(512) NULL, ADD COLUMN sp_relation_flag VARCHAR(32) NULL, ADD COLUMN evidence_folder_path VARCHAR(512) NULL, ADD COLUMN verification_status VARCHAR(32) NULL, ADD COLUMN verification_method VARCHAR(64) NULL, ADD COLUMN decision VARCHAR(32) NULL, ADD COLUMN final_outcome VARCHAR(255) NULL, ADD COLUMN created_by VARCHAR(255) NULL, ADD COLUMN modified_by VARCHAR(255) NULL, ADD COLUMN modified_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dsr_case_events ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, dsr_case_id BIGINT NOT NULL, case_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, event_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, actor VARCHAR(255), actor_role VARCHAR(64), from_status VARCHAR(64), to_status VARCHAR(64), note TEXT, investor_visible TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_dsr_events_case FOREIGN KEY (dsr_case_id) REFERENCES dsr_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_events_case ON dsr_case_events(dsr_case_id); CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_events_case_visible ON dsr_case_events(dsr_case_id, investor_visible);
